reconstruction_summary: Reconstructed agent's V3 (linear-bicycle steady-state) using per-platform fitted bias / ratio_scale / Kus parsed from out/run2.txt; predict = v / (L + Kus*v^2) * (delta_road - bias) / ratio_scale.
notes: Coefficients are platform-specific (Mach-E vs F-150 Lightning); applied each per-segment by platform. Parameters were fit by the agent on their 80% train split — applying them to all 545 Ford segments includes both train and test segments. Linear-fit generalisation per leakage_note. baseline_rmse_recomputed matches the canonical V0 to <1e-6.
